## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in the framework.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python3 -m compileall -q clinical_lidar`
- [ ] Browser smoke test completed if the webapp changed
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when behavior or release scope changed

## Safety and provenance

- [ ] No patient data, identifiers, credentials, or protected captures included
- [ ] No diagnostic, healing, treatment, or regulatory claim added
- [ ] Third-party code, models, data, and assets have documented licenses
- [ ] New model/data work includes the relevant card and validation plan
